sentences.text: The original home loan agreement states a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding in clause 9.3.
The copy of the home loan agreement states a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding in clause 9.3.
The two documents do not state the same pre-payment charge in clause 9.3.
The agreement says it was executed in duplicate, and the borrower acknowledges receiving a copy of the agreement with all its schedules.
